Vendored tz-lookup 6.1.25 from npm (CC0; see LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/darkskyapp/tz-lookup

Offline coordinate-to-IANA lookup, approximately 73 KB. Boundary lookup is approximate; users can override either endpoint. Date-specific offsets come from the browser Intl timezone database, not this geographic dataset. Update the pinned vendor data when geographic timezone boundaries change.
